newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Moroccan minister visits Germany for telcoms talks.
newsitem.headline: Moroccan minister visits Germany for telcoms talks.

text.p: Moroccan Privatisation Minister Abderrahman Saaidi will pay a two-day visit to Germany starting on Tuesday to discuss investment in Morocco and Germany's experience in privatising telecommunications.
In a statement carried by the official news agency MAP, the ministry said Saaidi would brief German Economics Minister Guenter Rexrodt on Rabat's programme to dispose of state holdings in companies.
It said Saaidi would also meet Post and Telecommunications Minister Wolfgang Boetsch to discuss his experience with the privatisation of German Telecom.

Morocco plans to split its telecommunications and postal services (ONPT) into two enterprises called Ittissalat al-Maghrib and Barid al-Maghrib. Privatisation will first target GSM phones then be extended to the whole network.
Morocco with a population of 27 million people has only four telephone lines per 100 people and 30,000 GSM subscribers.
Saaidi will also meet German businessmen and brief them on investment opportunities in the North African country, either through direct investment or through the stock exchange.
